special_situations.headline: Intimation of record date with respect to the Rights Issue
special_situations.summary: Board approved ₹90.88 Cr CCPS+warrant rights issue terms and Aug 25 record date
special_situations.impact: ~112% of FY26 revenue (₹90.88 Cr raise vs ₹81.23 Cr FY26 revenue)
special_situations.risk: Complex CCPS+warrant structure with 60-month conversion adds dilution uncertainty
special_situations.view_reasoning: FY26 profit turnaround to ₹41.5 Cr and zero net debt, but raise size vs revenue is outsized

special_situations.headline: The Board of Directors at meeting held today i.e., August 19, 2026 Considered and approved the terms of the Rights issue
special_situations.summary: Board finalized ₹59.96 Cr rights issue terms: 44:15 ratio at ₹10/share
special_situations.impact: ~147% of trailing revenue (₹59.96 Cr raise vs ~₹40.7 Cr revenue per Screener)
special_situations.risk: Tiny NBFC, promoters hold only 10% with 41% of that pledged
special_situations.view_reasoning: Penny-stock NBFC (~₹23 Cr market cap) nearly quadrupling share count via dilutive rights issue

special_situations.headline: The Board of Directors at meeting held today i.e., August 19, 2026 has fixed the Record date for the purpose of Rights issue i.e., August 25, 2026
special_situations.summary: Board approved terms of ~₹60 crore rights issue for equity shares.
special_situations.impact: ~281% of FY23 revenue (₹60 Cr raise vs ₹21.35 Cr FY23 revenue); market cap only ~₹22.5 Cr
special_situations.risk: Heavy dilution; weak fundamentals, declining revenue, 41% promoter pledge
special_situations.view_reasoning: NBFC with falling revenue, low 8.54% ROE, pledged promoter stock; large dilutive raise adds risk.

special_situations.headline: The Exchange has received Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 on August 20, 2026 for Lloyds Enterprises Ltd
special_situations.summary: Promoter Lloyds Enterprises files SEBI encumbrance disclosure on its LEWL stake
special_situations.impact: Likely tied to ₹219 Cr Tata Capital loan pledge (4.05% stake) funding SISCOL acquisition, vs ₹1,301 Cr FY26 revenue
special_situations.risk: Rising promoter-level leverage amid aggressive M&A and ₹5,250 Cr related-party limit
special_situations.view_reasoning: Strong FY26 growth (revenue +54%, PAT +88%) but promoter pledging and heavy M&A raise leverage/governance flags

special_situations.headline: Outcome of the meeting of the Rights Issue Committee of the Board of Directors of Quint Digital Limited
special_situations.summary: Rights Issue Committee finalized ₹90.88 Cr CCPS-plus-warrants rights issue terms
special_situations.impact: ~112% of FY26 revenue (₹90.88 Cr raise vs ₹81.23 Cr FY26 operational revenue)
special_situations.risk: Significant dilution; CCPS conversion terms/pricing not yet disclosed
special_situations.view_reasoning: Large capital raise relative to small revenue base; outcome depends on subscription and conversion terms.

special_situations.headline: Board at its meeting held today, i.e. on August 19, 2026, has, inter alia considered, approved and fixed the terms of the rights issue including issue price and Record Date.

special_situations.impact: ~147% of FY revenue (₹60 Cr raise vs ₹40.7 Cr revenue; market cap only ~₹23 Cr)

special_situations.view_reasoning: Raise size dwarfs market cap/revenue; weak NBFC fundamentals and high promoter pledge signal distress-driven capital need.
